scope: Local actual current source and accepted product documents; native keymap subset independently checked by keymap_parity subagent. No new native build, compiled execution or device proof.

recommendation.direction: Prefer a device input policy that omits only the explicitly paired synthetic one-finger PAN from a proved physical Pencil original VIEW3D exposed-canvas precision contact. Apply independently of selected native tool identity, including Knife, Annotate and Measure, while preserving the ordinary precision cursor/down/up stream.
recommendation.reason: The Pencil already produces a native precision mouse stream. Duplicating its motion into TRACKPADPAN can invoke unrelated navigation or native modal size changes. A canvas/device policy does not assert what arbitrary current keymaps or polls will do with the initial DOWN, so it covers same-batch first invocation without predicting that Knife will start.
recommendation.scope_bound: Only the physical Pencil precision suffix after existing ring, HUD/navigation/resize/direct-tool captures and finger branches. Require an original completed exposed VIEW3D canvas receipt and fresh native validation. Initially exclude explicit flythrough/navigation mode rather than silently changing its policy.
recommendation.not_ready: There is no general completed-canvas original-contact suppression receipt or proved pre-recognition invalidation path in current production. Existing paint receipt is paint-specific and current navigation/tool registry is not a proof for all VIEW3D canvas. This report authorizes no shortcut from actor, numFingers, current mode, tool name or absence of a navigation hit.
recommendation.packet_invariants: Do not change initial recognized cursor/down location, packet count/order except paired PAN omission, relative translation cache updates, per-action pressure/tilt snapshot, keyboard modifiers, native click/drag admission, terminal release/flags, or existing paint lease. Do not route through ToolManipulation.
recommendation.parity_limit: This is a deliberate physical-device mapping correction, not proof that every native modal/custom TRACKPADPAN consumer behaves identically. Specific native size mappings and custom bindings must be acknowledged and exercised.

accepted_workflow_evidence.finding: Finger navigation/general UI and Pencil precision/creative input are the guiding distinction; pressure/tilt/hover retained and each new mapping needs a purpose.
Native Pan/Move must accept Pencil press-drag just as Zoom does; preserve fingers, external input and approved radial/Pencil mappings.
Navigation controls accept finger/Pencil press-drag-release with mouse-equivalent behavior; retain finger scrolling, external pointer/hot-plug, native editors and desktop behavior.
Personal Pencil-first everyday editing is the priority; preserve native Blender editors, Inspector, Files, safe operation ownership and supported hardware.

actual_pipeline.finding: ios_touch_device reads physical UITouch.type. GestureContact starts from exactly one actual touch before superclass physical Begin; Pencil actor/serial and samples are recognizer-owned. Generic contact currently does not retain its physical origin outside specialized ring/HUD/paint receipts.

TouchDevice/PencilSample/GestureContact bind actor, value-only touch identity, unique Pencil serial, current sample and down state. This is physical actor evidence, not canvas evidence or tool admission.

Touch admission/hardware reject first, then original ring route, then HUD/navigation/workspace/direct-tool PointerCapture, then finger scroll/flythrough. These paths return before the physical Pencil precision suffix.

Precision path retains tablet and existing paint receipt. Began emits recognized current CURSOR/DOWN and caches translation; Changed appends paired PAN before CURSOR unless paint-tagged; terminal emits existing UP only. Omission can be local to PAN append without changing ordinary native mouse semantics.

generateUserInputEvents batches events, cursor/button preserve tablet provenance; PAN becomes GHOST_EventTrackpad Scroll numFingers=1 without Pencil actor/serial/origin/pair token. Physical actor evidence is lost in this PAN constructor.
Single direct/Pencil recognizer, indirect left-drag, direct/indirect two/three-finger and scroll-only recognizers are separate paths. Excluding only the paired precision PAN can retain them.
Native Knife passes MOUSEPAN; the previously recorded Ctrl paired-PAN zoom remains source-reachable. Current source-only review did not rerun timing or numerical reproduction.

Trackpad conversion writes shared event_state xy and coalesces queued trackpad events before semantic handlers. Late handler suppression cannot undo those mutations. Do not identify Pencil from numFingers=1.

native_keymaps_and_intent.finding: Annotate native maps use ordinary tool PRESS, with Ctrl eraser, or native tweak event. No paired TRACKPADPAN dependency appears in these tool maps.
Measure uses tool_maybe_tweak_event for ruler_add; ordinary down/motion routing must remain exact.

Knife initial plain PRESS uses wait_for_input=False; later Ctrl/Shift native modal events control ignore-snap/midpoint state, and MIDDLEMOUSE starts native PANNING. Do not force Knife admission or clear initial/later modifiers.
Default viewport TRACKPADPAN bindings provide orbit/pan and Ctrl zoom. They must remain for genuine finger/indirect trackpad streams.

Native USER_TWOBUTTONMOUSE Alt/OSKey LEFTMOUSE-to-MIDDLEMOUSE emulation includes matching release. Deliberate Pencil+modifier mouse navigation can remain because ordinary cursor/down/up and physical modifiers remain; exercise it explicitly.

Material parity risk: native Transform maps TRACKPADPAN to PROPORTIONAL_SIZE and Circle Select maps it to SIZE. Broad omission also removes duplicate-motion radius/size changes from a physical Pencil precision stream; do not call every suppressed PAN navigation-only.

TFM_MODAL_PROPSIZE consumes native mapped PAN displacement and changes proportional radius. Direct ToolManipulation transforms already bypass the precision suffix, but keyboard-started/native other transform paths need separate controls.
GESTURE_MODAL_CIRCLE_SIZE changes Circle Select radius from mapped PAN xy delta, while ordinary MOUSEMOVE updates position/applies selection.
Native Blender Fly modal also maps TRACKPADPAN to CONFIRM. The separate iPad flythrough flag changes routing; do not infer that general exposed VIEW3D means precision editing in navigation mode.

presentation_and_classification_gaps.finding: navigation_regions gives first-hit Navigation/WorkspaceResize/ToolManipulation and original HUD contact capture, but absence is not positive exposed-canvas evidence. Selection and ToolManipulation are tool-specific policies, not general canvas classification.

End-of-draw navigation publication includes resize, HUD/native navigation and only direct_edit_tool canvas regions. Visible popups clear registry. It does not publish general completed per-texture canvas provenance for Knife/Annotate/Measure.
Completed paint presentation registry includes generation/region and frozen original paint origin, but it is admitted by paint-specific native profile and cannot stand in for all VIEW3D canvas.
ED_ipad_finger_paint_capture only admits mesh Sculpt/Vertex/Weight/Texture paint with native brush flag, live tool and non-curve brush; it excludes ordinary Knife/Annotate/Measure.

Paint compositor demonstrates actual layer blockers, last texture generation, live fresh owner lookup, modal/popup/gesture/opaque callback exclusions and navigation/shelf subtraction. Broad canvas policy needs corresponding coherent completed evidence rather than widening paint ownership.

ipad_canvas_rect derives from layout and editing_canvas_parts removes shelf. Geometry alone is not proof that matching current canvas pixels were actually presented or that every higher UI/native widget is absent.

Plain LEFTMOUSE canvas input can dismiss/rehost panels. Suppression-only packet preservation must retain that native behavior; do not use direct_tool to protect a stroke because that changes initial interaction.

invalidation_obligations_before_any_impl: Capture a dedicated value-only original physical Pencil actor/serial, actual window lifetime/native view, exact physical origin, VIEW3D area/WINDOW identity/lifetime, completed canvas texture/presentation generation and exposed part before superclass touchesBegan can recognize or emit actions.

At the first recognized action and every later omission, prove fresh original native window/screen/workspace/area/region membership, matching original presentation and actual current higher UI/nav classification without callback-driven mutation between validation and admission. Do not dereference saved addresses or accept address reuse.

A->B->A must not revive a stale contact just because current geometry/tool/screen matches again. Generation/lifetime changes or a callback-free validation barrier must cover pre-recognition changes; tool-intent equality is unnecessary for the broad policy but presentation/context transitions are still relevant.

Cover screen/workspace/layout/header/quad/split/rotation/scale/buffer resize, tool or mode changes, panel dismiss/rehost/lock, shelf, Inspector/Tools/rails/native navigation, ring/HUD/page replacement, ordinary/native popups, overlapping regions and unknown/opaque window or region draw callbacks, including callback self-removal.

Maintain Navigation/WorkspaceResize/ToolManipulation and ring/HUD priority from actual original contact. Do not classify an absent/cleared navigation registry, generic inputmode, actor alone or numFingers alone as canvas.
Explicitly keep flythrough/navigation mode outside initial precision-canvas admission. Mode is a policy exclusion, not evidence of a physical Pencil or exposed canvas.

Hardware ownership, pending-stream interruption, native view/window teardown and UIKit reset must invalidate the suppression receipt through the old stream; fresh next contacts remain eligible. No new terminal lease, unleased release, replacement Cancel, forced Finish or old-pointer owner invocation.

Same UIKit batch may queue CURSOR/DOWN/PAN/CURSOR before the first DOWN invokes an operator. Canvas/device proof must suffice without requiring a live Knife or pretending arbitrary native keymaps/polls will accept DOWN.

Freeze the precise original contract: stale/unknown proof never grants omission; preserve baseline ordinary packets and current existing paint ownership/terminal behavior. Do not silently upgrade this suppression hint into a WM semantic owner token.
minimum_acceptance_matrix_for_a_later_ca: Historical exact-source Ctrl-Knife PAN->zoom control retained; candidate omits only paired PAN, with exact recognized cursor/down/up/order/translation/tablet/modifiers unchanged.
First same-batch DOWN/PAN before native Knife exists; existing original Knife; later Ctrl/Shift and modified initial DOWN fallback; real custom down/motion keymaps and denied native poll.
Annotate plain/line/polygon/eraser and Ctrl eraser; Measure drag/gizmo interaction; keyboard-started/native Transform proportional size and Circle Select radius controls characterized honestly.

Native Pencil Pan/Move/Rotate/Zoom controls, Alt/OSKey middle emulation, native keyboard-invoked navigation, explicit flythrough unchanged; hardware/indirect scroll and finger/two/three-finger paths exact.
Pencil UI, numeric fields, Tools/Inspector/rails/HUD/ring, other editors and popup scrolling retain ordinary paired PAN where appropriate; no global PencilPAN deletion.

Before-threshold and during-contact presentation/context changes including A->B->A, split/quad/rotation and reused owners, opaque callback changes and original window close cannot grant stale suppression.
Exact broad policy compatibility statement acknowledges native/custom TRACKPADPAN consumers; no all-keymap or all-native-editing parity claim.

Run coherent source fixtures/full retained checks/pinned-source preflight/independent source review, then exact native build/package/actual compiled producer and new receipt-consumer evidence before ready; device behavior remains separately unproved.
bottom_line: The broader physical Pencil exposed-canvas precision policy is a more coherent next direction than Knife-only tool-intent prediction. It reduces the proof to actor/original presentation/liveness rather than arbitrary operator invocation. It is not currently implementation-ready, and its native size/custom TRACKPADPAN compatibility limits are material.
